about: Year figures for the first row of the Overview, one per column. value is minutes for the two times, a 0-1 share for the shares and a patient count for EIP (max is EIP's highest count at once). null leaves the column's year cell empty. Replace each figure with Rockyview's own when it arrives (EDSim-Dev issue #4, workstream E).

waitToSeeDoctor.source: AHS 2024-25 Annual Report: ED wait time to see a doctor, 50th percentile, Calgary Zone (provincial 150 min)

admittedTotalTime.source: AHS 2024-25 Annual Report: total time in ED for admitted patients, 50th percentile, Calgary Zone (provincial 804 min)

lwbs.source: Estimate from a Rockyview ED physician at the 2026 dashboard review; replace with the measured rate
